hints.tr: Metni tarihe çevirmek: `pd.Timestamp(text)`. Sonra `+ pd.Timedelta(days=30)` ve `+ pd.DateOffset(months=1)`.
hints.en: Turn the text into a date: `pd.Timestamp(text)`. Then `+ pd.Timedelta(days=30)` and `+ pd.DateOffset(months=1)`.

hints.tr: Ay sonu: `day + MonthEnd(0)`. Kalan gün: `(month_end - day).days`.
hints.en: The month end: `day + MonthEnd(0)`. Days left: `(month_end - day).days`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd
from pandas.tseries.offsets import MonthEnd

starts = ["2024-01-31", "2024-02-29", "2024-03-31", "2024-08-30"]

for text in starts:
    start = pd.Timestamp(text)
    by_days = start + pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    by_month = start + pd.DateOffset(months=1)
    print(text, by_days.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), by_month.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))

day = pd.Timestamp("2024-03-09")
month_end = day + MonthEnd(0)
print(month_end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
print((month_end - day).days)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd
from pandas.tseries.offsets import MonthEnd

starts = ["2024-01-31", "2024-02-29", "2024-03-31", "2024-08-30"]

for text in starts:
    start = pd.Timestamp(text)
    by_days = start + pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    by_month = start + pd.DateOffset(months=1)
    print(text, by_days.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), by_month.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))

day = pd.Timestamp("2024-03-09")
month_end = day + MonthEnd(0)
print(month_end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
print((month_end - day).days)
```
